_fixture_purpose: Edge-case CRS metadata record. Describes a raster that is in EPSG:4326 (geographic, NOT projected) with its centroid over Assam (~93°E). The correct UTM target zone is EPSG:32646 (zone 46N). Used to verify normalize_crs() selects the right zone dynamically rather than defaulting to the hardcoded EPSG:32643.
note: UTM zones are 6° wide. Assam (92-95°E) falls in zone 46. Using EPSG:32643 (zone 43, valid for 72-78°E) introduces ~3-zone offset — approx 150-250 km horizontal displacement error.
